work.text: Inference and GPU rental served from RTX 4090 or RTX 5090 nodes whose power is certified renewable and whose location is proven. The application checklist asks for eight-card nodes, a registered business, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certificates, two 10 Gbps lines and staff on site around the clock. No task specification or protocol is published anywhere; there is no repository.
work.quote: Once verified, connect RTX 4090 or RTX 5090 nodes to Bittensor subnet 110.

scoring.text: Unknown. Looked for a scoring formula, validator code or an incentive document on the front page, the about, providers, enterprise and apply pages, in the chain identity (github_repo unset) and the index; found one sentence, that validators score performance, reliability and proof integrity, and a yield calculator that applies a 1.5x green multiplier. No repository, no endpoint, no document.

split.text: Unknown. Looked for how the miner share divides between miners on every site page, in the chain identity and in the index. The providers page says validators route demand by performance, reliability and attestation and that payouts come every epoch; nothing says whether the split is proportional, winner-heavy or floored. On the 2026-09-09 snapshot there was one active miner to divide it among.

judges.text: Thirteen validators were active on the 2026-09-09 chain snapshot, against one miner. Commit-reveal is off, weights at most once per 100 blocks. What the validators do is one sentence on the providers page: route inference demand and score performance, reliability and the integrity of the green-power attestation. Whether they re-run work, sample it or read a meter is not stated, and there is no code to read.
judges.quote: commit_reveal_weights_enabled False, weights_rate_limit 100; chain-2026-09-09.json active_validators 13, active_miners 1

cadence.text: Emission settles every 360 blocks, about 72 minutes; the site promises payouts every epoch and names no other round, window or challenge. A new registration is immune from deregistration for 5,000 blocks, about 16 hours. The registration burn was 0.0005 TAO on the 2026-09-09 snapshot, described on the apply page as non-refundable if onboarding fails.

buyer.text: Enterprise teams paying in ordinary money, plus self-serve renters with a $5 minimum top-up. Prices are RTX 4090 from $0.40 and RTX 5090 from $0.70 per GPU hour, marked indicative, through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The front page claims $82,000 revenue in June 2026 and an $8,200 buyback with a wallet address. No customer is named outside testimonials.
buyer.quote: We sell inference. Enterprise grade, production ready, metered by the token.

exploits.text: No incident is recorded on any site page. The stated guard is admission: a carbon-registry attestation and a hardware location proof before a node is registered, with the registration burn lost if onboarding fails. Whether attestation is re-checked after admission, or what happens to a miner whose power turns out dirty, is not stated. Looked for gaming, sybil or abuse statements on every page and found none.
exploits.quote: The floor is simple: no proof, no payout.
